name: Fanjingshan
description: Fanjingshan rises to 2,570 metres in the Wuling Mountains of Guizhou, south-west China. It is an island of ancient metamorphic rock surrounded by a sea of karst, and its isolation has sheltered rare species like the Guizhou snub-nosed monkey and the Fanjingshan fir. Its slopes hold vast primeval beech forest, and the peak is also a sacred Buddhist mountain.
